decision_conditions:
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">The
proposed two-storey attached outbuilding, by reason of its siting, scale, and
prominent location to the front of the host property, would appear as an
incongruous and visually intrusive addition to the streetscene. Furthermore,
the site directly abuts the Belmont Lane Green Chain and designated open space.
The development would fail to respect the established character and spatial
qualities of the surrounding area. The proposed structure would result in an
unacceptable encroachment on the openness and visual amenity of this sensitive
area, undermining its function as a green corridor and detracting from its
landscape value.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">&nbsp;</p><p>



</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">As such,
the proposal is considered to represent an inappropriate development &nbsp;contrary to high quality design aspirations of
the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policy D3 and G4 of the London
Plan (2021), Core Policy CS1 (B) of the Harrow Core Strategy (2012), policy DM
1 of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013) and the
adopted Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2010).<span style="font-size:12.0pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-fareast-font-family:
&quot;Times New Roman&quot;;mso-bidi-font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;"><o:p></o:p></span></p>
description: Two storey attached outbuilding to front for use as Garage/Study/Gym (Demolition of side extension and garage)
